name: omnigami-product-film
description: Launch video from your product's real screens: 34 seconds in five acts (problem, promise, the product at work, result, ask) with a big cursor, a moving camera, captions and sound, in wide, square and tall, with an optional narrated version. Use when the user asks for a launch video, product video, promo, demo video, teaser or motion graphics for their product, app or website.
